steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, submit your formal PMI application with proof of education and project experience. Pay the exam fee through PMI's portal. Granite PM Academy staff can guide you through the submission process to ensure accuracy and avoid delays.

Granite PM Academy offers ongoing learning paths aligned with PMI standards. Renew before expiration to protect your investment and stay current in your career.
